title: Since I came here
goal: Say since when something has gone on with -AlY bäri, and tell a trip with every converb of the unit.

intro.text: **Since** (someone) did something is `-(A)lY` and *bäri*: *bu ýere geleli bäri* (since I came here). The shape is that of **let's** (*Geleli!*), but *bäri* makes it **since**. For what still goes on, the last verb is in the present: *Göçeli bäri şu ýerde ýaşaýarys* (since moving we've lived here).

vocab.en: See you! Until we meet again!

Maral Londondan. Ol Aşgabada geleli bäri, türkmen dilini öwrenýär. Geçen aý ol dosty Selbi bilen Köneürgenje gitdi. Ýola çykmazdan öň, olar Köneürgenç barada köp okadylar.

Myhmanhana baryp, sumkalaryny goýandan soň, derrew Gutlug Temir minarasyna gitdiler. Minara örän beýikdi! Maral hiç zat diýmän, oňa seredip durdy. Olar ýadaýança, gadymy kümmetleriň arasynda gezdiler.
exercises.translation: Maral is from London. Since coming to Ashgabat, she has been learning Turkmen. Last month she went to Köneürgenç with her friend Selbi. Before setting off, they read a lot about Köneürgenç. The train left early in the morning. Until they reached Dashoguz, Selbi spoke only Turkmen with Maral. From Dashoguz they took a bus to Köneürgenç. After going to the hotel and leaving their bags, they went straight to the minaret of Kutlug Timur. The minaret was very tall! Maral stood looking at it without saying anything. They walked among the old mausoleums until they were tired.
